key_results: Nusselt number increases monotonically with rib height ratio (1.29→1.42), but friction factor increases 2.05→4.30; thermal performance factor η₁ decreases 1.016→0.870; admissible RHR contracts from 4.41 at Re=2×10⁴ to 1.36 at Re=8×10⁴
comments: Rigorous RANS simulations with clear physical mechanism explanation (flow deflection away from wall); uniform arrays outperform all graded variants under equal-pumping-power constraint, though grading remains viable when heat transfer dominates.

model_io.model: 3D steady RANS with SST k-ω turbulence model
inputs: channel geometry with five square ribs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Grading rib height enhances heat transfer while maintaining efficient pumping
hypotheses.result: Partially rejected; heat transfer improves but pumping penalty too high; uniform arrays superior under equal-power constraint

title: Estimating vehicular emissions by applying deep learning on video camera scenes
task: Estimate vehicular emissions from street video via deep learning and COPERT model
key_results: 2.3 million image dataset covering 4,923 car models; vehicle speed and acceleration extracted via tracking; emissions computed via modified COPERT; demonstrates real-time traffic flow analysis and scalability potential in Amsterdam and Abu Dhabi
comments: End-to-end pipeline from video to emission estimates is well-motivated for urban air-quality monitoring; specific quantitative validation metrics (e.g., MAE vs. on-vehicle measurements) absent; generalization to diverse urban contexts unclear.

model_io.model: Vehicle classification CNN + tracking + COPERT emission model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video-based vehicle classification and tracking enables high-resolution urban emission monitoring without instrumented vehicles
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; deployable in Amsterdam and Abu Dhabi; quantitative validation vs. ground truth sparse

title: Adaptive personalized over-the-air federated learning with reflecting intelligent surfaces
task: Optimize federated learning resource allocation over heterogeneous edge network with RIS and non-convex objective
key_results: Adaptive local steps, power, and RIS configuration jointly optimized; convergence analysis provided; personalized learning extension supports heterogeneous objectives; outperforms state-of-the-art joint communication-learning baselines under channel noise and estimation error
comments: Cross-layer framework integrating communication (uplink/downlink power control, RIS), computation (local steps), and learning (non-convex optimization) is comprehensive; channel noise and estimation errors realistically modeled; quantitative speedups not disclosed.

model_io.model: Federated learning with adaptive resource allocation over RIS-assisted edge network
outputs: resource allocation (power, local steps, RIS config)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint optimization of communication, computation, and learning resources improves federated learning convergence over heterogeneous networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms baselines; personalized extension supports diverse objectives

title: LLM4MG: adapting large language model for multipath generation via synesthesia of machines
task: Adapt large language model for multipath channel generation via multi-modal sensory data fusion
key_results: LLM4MG (LLaMA 3.2 + LoRA fine-tuning + multi-modal fusion) outperforms conventional deep learning in LoS/NLoS classification, multipath power/delay generation precision, and cross-vehicular traffic density/band/scenario generalization; validated via real-world generalization
comments: Multi-modal sensing-communication dataset (SynthSoM-V2I) newly constructed; synesthesia-of-machines framework bridges heterogeneous sensory modalities elegantly; LoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning practical; 6G V2I context forward-looking; quantitative benchmarks sparse.

model_io.model: LLaMA 3.2 with LoRA fine-tuning + multi-modal feature extraction/fusion networks

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM adapted via LoRA and multi-modal fusion outperforms conventional deep learning for 6G multipath generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cross-VTD/band/scenario generalization superior; quantitative metrics not detailed

title: Single-cell atlas of transcriptomic vulnerability across brain disorders
task: Map transcriptomic vulnerability across neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric diseases
key_results: Single-cell atlas of 6.3 million nuclei from 1,494 donors reveals universal cross-disease signatures in mRNA processing and protein localization; AD shows reduced neuronal abundance with increased immune/vascular cells; deep-layer excitatory neurons associated with neuropsychiatric symptoms in AD
comments: Large population-scale study provides valuable reference but interindividual variation confounds disease-specific mechanisms.

inputs: tissue from neurotypical controls and 8 disease cohorts (AD, DLBD, Vas, PD, tauopathy, FTD, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-disease transcriptomic signatures exist distinct from disease-specific alterations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; universal signatures in mRNA processing and protein localization identified across diseases

hypotheses.hypothesis: AD phenotypes exhibit transcriptomic changes distinct from healthy aging
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; severe AD characterized by reduced neuronal abundance and increased immune/vascular populations

title: Neuronal detection of social actions directs collective escape behaviour
task: Identify neural mechanisms mediating collective escape through social information
key_results: Midbrain optic tectum and thalamic neurons show selective response to virtual conspecific escape motion but not non-biological linear motion; fish behaviorally retreat only to biologically plausible escape trajectories
comments: Elegant use of virtual stimuli isolates social encoding, though generalization to natural multi-sensory contexts remains unclear.

model_io.model: Adult glassfish (Danionella cerebrum) viewing virtual conspecifics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual neurons encode socially transmitted danger information from escaping conspecifics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; midbrain and thalamic escape-responsive neurons activated by virtual escape or disappearance of conspecifics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neural social encoding is selective for biological motion patterns
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; escape-responsive neurons unaffected by non-biological linear motion; behavioral responses only to burst-and-glide motion

title: The lipidomic architecture of the mouse brain
task: Map spatial organization of brain lipidome and its adaptation during pregnancy
key_results: Micrometric lipid atlas reveals 'lipizones' that align with functional anatomy and capture axon terminals distinct from cell-type territories; white matter metabolically activated and cortical layer 4 undergoes lipizone-specific remodeling in pregnant females
comments: Novel lipidomic perspective complements transcriptomic atlases but functional consequence of lipid remodeling remains to be established.

model_io.model: Adult and pregnant mouse brain tissue
inputs: brain tissue across sexes and pregnancy states

hypotheses.hypothesis: Brain membrane lipids organize into biochemically distinct territories ('lipizones') that align with functional anatomy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lipizones partially mirror cell-type territories and capture distal axon terminals

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pregnancy drives physiological remodeling of brain lipidome architecture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; white matter metabolic activation and cortex layer 4-specific lipidomic remodeling in pregnant females

title: mTORC1 drives cell-autonomous astrocyte reactivity in tuberous sclerosis
task: Determine whether glial dysfunction drives TSC pathogenesis or results from seizure activity
key_results: TSC2 loss cell-autonomously biases progenitors to reactive astrocytes with downregulated glutamate transporters, increased inflammatory cytokine secretion, and elevated neurodegeneration risk genes (APOE, CLU); effect observed in organoids without seizures
comments: Elegant use of organoid models disentangles intrinsic glial effects from secondary seizure consequences, implicating astrocytes as drivers rather than bystanders.

model_io.model: Human brain organoids and patient-resected tuber tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: TSC2 loss cell-autonomously drives astrocyte reactivity independent of seizure activity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reactive astrocytes emerge in organoids lacking seizures and in resected tuber tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutant reactive astrocytes exhibit neurodegeneration-associated molecular signatures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated APOE and CLU expression, impaired glutamate clearance capacity

title: Efficient field-free magnetization switching through orbital-current-enhanced magnon torque
task: Achieve efficient field-free magnetization switching via orbital-current-enhanced magnon torque in RuO₂/NiO/ferromagnet
key_results: High in-plane (143.8 × 10³) and out-of-plane (8.3 × 10³) spin Hall conductivity; field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization with low power
comments: Joint excitation of magnons by spin and orbital currents provides a low-dissipation route to magnetization control, promising for spintronic devices.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital currents jointly with spin currents excite magnon currents in NiO
hypotheses.result: Efficient field-free perpendicular magnetization switching achieved; high spin Hall conductivity measured

title: Berry curvature dipole generation and nonreciprocal spin photocurrents in ferroelectricity polarized heterostructures
task: Generate berry curvature dipole via ferroelectric polarization-driven symmetry breaking in WSe₂/LiNbO₃
key_results: Nonreciprocal circular galvanic photocurrent with asymmetry factor of 12; pronounced Berry curvature distribution induced by C₃ symmetry breaking
comments: Extends BCD engineering beyond monolayer regime using ferroelectric substrates, enabling practical quantum geometric control in thicker semiconductors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferroelectric polarization breaks WSe₂ C₃ symmetry and generates BCD
hypotheses.result: Nonreciprocal photocurrent and strongly anisotropic Berry curvature confirmed

title: Interlayer hybridization promotes superconductivity in bilayer nickelates
task: Elucidate interlayer hybridization mechanism driving superconductivity in bilayer nickelates (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇
key_results: Coherent d_{z²}–pz–d_{z²} interlayer hybridization identified; suppressed static spin order and damped spin excitations correlate with superconductivity; oxygen stoichiometry and strain tune interlayer channel
comments: Multiorbital picture of superconductivity in nickelates established via XAFS/RIXS on capped thin films; narrow regime of interlayer coherence constrains pairing mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interlayer d_{z²}–pz–d_{z²} hybridization mediates superconductivity
hypotheses.result: Coherent interlayer hybridization observed in SC phase; suppressed spin order and damped excitations confirmed via RIXS

title: String-breaking dynamics in a quantum simulator
task: Probe string-breaking dynamics in Z₂ lattice gauge theory via trapped-ion quantum simulator
key_results: Observation of charge-pair formation at string edges and subsequent spreading; coherent oscillations of localized charges as tension increases; dynamics distinct from Schwinger mechanism
comments: Spatiotemporally resolved string-breaking simulation provides direct quantum-simulator insight into QFT dynamics inaccessible classically.

model_io.model: Trapped-ion quantum simulator for Z₂ lattice gauge theory

hypotheses.hypothesis: Abrupt increase of string tension triggers dynamical breaking via pair creation
hypotheses.result: Charge pairs observed at string edges; spreading dynamics distinct from conventional Schwinger mechanism

title: Quantum many-body mixed phase space revealed by hybrid feedback control
task: Reveal quantum many-body mixed phase space via hybrid feedback control on superconducting processor
key_results: Autonomously stabilized long-lived regular trajectories in superconducting qubits; signatures of mixed phase space without classical analogue
comments: Hybrid quantum-classical feedback provides an algorithmic route to discovering coherent dynamics, though scalability to larger systems remains open.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid feedback stabilizes coherent orbits in chaotic quantum many-body dynamics
hypotheses.result: Long-lived regular trajectories extracted from chaotic evolution; mixed phase space signatures observed

title: Anomalous metal and superconducting phases in rhombohedral graphene
task: Characterize anomalous metal and superconducting phases in rhombohedral graphene on WSe₂
key_results: Gate-tunable zero-resistance superconductivity coexisting with finite-resistance anomalous metal; sharp boundary in gate space at millikelvin base temperature
comments: Ultra-clean graphene platform provides strong constraints on models of anomalous metals, but mechanism remains theoretically unresolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: In-plane field merges zero-resistance and finite-resistance superconducting pockets
hypotheses.result: Field-tunable transition observed between zero and finite resistance states

title: Lu+ optical frequency references with accuracy verified at the 19th digit
task: Demonstrate 176Lu⁺ optical frequency references with 10⁻¹⁹-level accuracy via correlation spectroscopy
key_results: Two independent systems agree to 5.7 × 10⁻¹⁹ fractional frequency difference; uncertainty < 10⁻¹⁸ in practical room-temperature systems
comments: Same-species comparison at the 10⁻¹⁹ level is unprecedented and crucial validation for proposed SI second redefinition; implications for fundamental tests remain significant.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Independent Lu⁺ systems can be directly compared at 10⁻¹⁹ level
hypotheses.result: Relative frequency difference measured as [−0.1 ± 5.7stat ± 1.0sys] × 10⁻¹⁹

title: A quadruped robot designed to complete a marathon on a single battery charge
task: Develop energy-efficient quadruped robot capable of marathon-distance locomotion on single charge
key_results: RAIBO2 completed marathon in 4 h 19 min 52 s on single battery; cost of transport = 0.25 (vs. human 0.37); 3× range extension vs. existing quadrupeds
comments: Holistic energy-loss optimization spanning hardware (force-transparent design, low-resistance motors) and software (low-dissipation gait) provides blueprint for legged robot efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated hardware-software optimization reduces total energy loss below wheeled benchmark
hypotheses.result: Cost of transport of 0.25 achieved; 3× range improvement over prior quadrupeds; marathon completion on single charge

title: Multi-directional control of a bio-inspired robot with a single undulating fin propulsion
task: Multi-directional control of underwater robot via modulated undulating fin propulsion
key_results: Station keeping, heading control, and path following achieved via amplitude modulation of counter-propagating waves; performance in wake flow demonstrated
comments: Bio-inspired flexible fin provides versatile control alternative to traditional propulsion; simple sinusoidal kinematics sufficient for complex maneuvers.

model_io.model: Underwater vehicle with undulating membrane fin

hypotheses.hypothesis: Time-varying and spatial modulations of traveling waves enable versatile motion control
hypotheses.result: Station keeping, heading control, path following, and wake navigation all achieved with simple sinusoidal drivers

title: First experimental results on range monitoring in carbon therapy with the TIARA detector
task: Demonstrate range monitoring for carbon-ion therapy via Prompt Gamma Timing with TIARA detector
key_results: Coincidence time resolution of 284 ± 32 ps FWHM; range accuracy of 4.74 ± 0.36 mm at clinical intensity with 5600 detected gammas
comments: First clinical validation of PGT with carbons shows viability but detector adaptations needed to handle fragmentation backgrounds and synchrotron timing.

model_io.model: TIARA detector with Prompt Gamma Timing

hypotheses.hypothesis: PGT-based range monitoring remains viable for high-LET carbon ions
hypotheses.result: 4.74 mm range accuracy achieved despite increased secondary fragment background

hypotheses.result: Exact Fermi–Dirac profile and universal interfacial properties match experiments quantitatively

title: Autonomous Floquet engineering of bosonic codes via reinforcement learning
task: Autonomous design of control waveforms for bosonic code preparation via reinforcement learning
key_results: 100× reduction in evolution time (1% of adiabatic schemes); high-fidelity state generation under dissipative and dephasing noise
comments: Combines Floquet engineering with RL for practical quantum error correction, addressing a key bottleneck in continuous-variable quantum computing.

hypotheses.result: Achieved ~100× time reduction while maintaining fidelity under noise

key_results: Fractional frequency stability of 1.2 × 10⁻¹³ at 1 s; enhanced Doppler-free amplitude with suppressed background noise

hypotheses.hypothesis: Polarization-selective coupling yields both EIT and absorption with enhanced Doppler-free contrast

task: Enable passive mmWave/sub-THz channel characterization via omnidirectional lens antennas
key_results: Uniform azimuthal radiation across 75–100 GHz and 220–300 GHz bands; realized gains 7–8 dBi; broadband impedance matching; extraction of channel parameters without mechanical scanning
comments: Wideband omnidirectional design scales to MIMO architectures and addresses 6G propagation modeling, though integration with full receiver chains remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.result: Stable azimuthal radiation with minimal angular bias across 75–300 GHz; full-wave simulations match measurements
